method: Fixed four-pixel derivative context; only edge support within the unchanged requested frame window is counted. No score or renderer change adopted.
decision: Use derivative context before cropping edge support. Keep frame eligibility anchored to actual frame evidence; exclude adjacent text through frame-specific support before adopting. This is a metric crop defect, not evidence of physical frame movement.
name: Aven Gagglemaster
finding: The old crop drops all330 actual bottom-frame edges from the reference and baseline. limitations: This validates the bottom frame edge, not all pose anchors or set completion. The report still uses the frozen original metric and common-eligible comparisons; no scores are silently replaced.
